notes.title: Update August 2, 2023
notes.content:
[New]
･Added "From Checkpoint" to the main menu.
(Starts from the last checkpoint reached.)

･Added one more checkpoint.
(Total of 6 checkpoints.)

･Added version notation in the lower right corner of the main menu.

[Change]
･Shortened the waiting time after falling to orz_floor.

･Changed gamepad controls.
Jump→Y, A, X, B
Walk→Left stick, D-pad

･The language selection can now be selected from a checklist.

[Bug fixes]
･Fixed a bug that caused low-resolution textures to be loaded for the first time.

･Fixed a bug related to animation.

･Fixed a visual bug caused by overlapping textures.

notes.title: Bug Fix July 25, 2023
notes.content:
Several bugs have been fixed.
･Bugs caused by collision.
･Bugs related to moving platform loading.
